findings.title: VPC without flow logs
findings.description: Without an aws_flow_log attached to the VPC, network traffic metadata is not captured and incident investigation is blind. Fail-safe: a VPC with no linked flow log is flagged. VPCs with no subnets carry no traffic and are skipped.

evidence.actual: no flow log attached to this VPC
evidence.expected: aws_flow_log with vpc_id referencing this VPC

findings.remediation: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

findings.title: VPC without DNS hostnames
findings.description: An aws_vpc with enable_dns_hostnames = false (the provider default) gives instances no public DNS hostnames, which breaks hostname-based service discovery and forces reliance on raw IPs. Enable DNS hostnames alongside DNS support.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.
